inside: notification API client and UiNotificationCenter drawer

causal_paths.input: Authenticated user archives one read active notification
transitions: service verifies recipient row and read state
service sets archived_at for that tenant and user
outputs: notification leaves ALL and UNREAD for that user only

causal_paths.input: Authenticated user selects ARCHIVED or restores an archived notification
transitions: view filter selects archived_at IS NOT NULL
restore clears archived_at for that tenant and user without changing read fields
outputs: archived page is pageable and filterable
restored notification returns to ALL as read

transitions: service updates rows scoped by tenant and user
update condition requires is_read = 1 and archived_at IS NULL
module and paging queries share the view predicate

causal_paths.input: Authenticated API call or legacy unreadOnly query
transitions: view defaults from view then legacy unreadOnly
mutation never deletes notification or recipient rows
